Name: ACTIONBUTTON_PARAM_ST
Description: Interaction prompts ("Open", "Talk", "Pick up item"): the region the player must stand in, the facing check, the text shown and the conditions that hide or grey it out. Registered by objects (ObjActParam), characters, items and other sources; when several prompts are available they are ordered by Category.

Fields.Name: Region Type
Fields.Description: Shape of the region the player must be in. 0 Cylinder: Radius, Region Angle, Height and Bottom Height Offset. 1 Prism: a box in front of Dummy Poly 1 (Depth, Width, Height, Bottom Height Offset). 2 Capsule: within Radius of the line between Dummy Poly 1 and 2 (height and facing are not checked). Other values: never shown.

Fields.Name: Category (Priority)
Fields.Description: Prompt group. Only the nearest prompt of each category is kept, and categories are ordered by a fixed priority, highest first: 0, 1, 14, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7, 12, 13, 8 to 10, 11; equal priority goes to the nearer one. 15 and above: never shown. Retail: 0 lost runes, 2 materials and items on the ground, 3 pick up item, 4 talk, 5 open / examine / levers, 7 summon signs, 8 bloodstains, 10 messages, 12 ride.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Dummy Poly 1
Fields.Description: Dummy poly on the registering object's model that the region is placed at, using its position and facing. -1 or not found: the object's own position and facing (a capsule needs both dummy polys).

Fields.Name: Dummy Poly 2
Fields.Description: Capsule only: second end of the capsule line. -1 or not found: the prompt is never shown.

Fields.Name: Radius
Fields.Description: Cylinder and capsule: horizontal radius in metres (capsule: distance from the line between the two dummy polys).

Fields.Name: Region Angle
Fields.Description: Cylinder only: the player must be within this many degrees either side of the dummy poly's facing, seen from the region centre. 180: all around.

Fields.Name: Depth
Fields.Description: Prism only: how far the box reaches in front of Dummy Poly 1, in metres. The player must be in front of the dummy poly and closer than this along its facing.

Fields.Name: Width
Fields.Description: Prism only: half-width of the box in metres; the box reaches this far to each side of the dummy poly's facing line.

Fields.Name: Height
Fields.Description: Cylinder and prism: height of the region in metres, measured up from the bottom (the dummy poly height plus Bottom Height Offset).

Fields.Name: Bottom Height Offset
Fields.Description: Cylinder and prism: raises (positive) or lowers (negative) the bottom of the region relative to the dummy poly, in metres. Retail rows usually start the region slightly below the dummy poly (-0.25 to -1).

Fields.Name: Facing Check Type
Fields.Description: Cylinder and prism: how the player's facing is checked against Facing Angle Tolerance. 0 Point: the player must face the region centre (the dummy poly). 1 Line: the player must face against the dummy poly's facing, wherever they stand. Other values: never shown.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Facing Angle Tolerance
Fields.Description: Cylinder and prism: how far (degrees) the player's facing may be off the direction Facing Check Type asks for. 180: any facing.

Fields.Name: Action Spot Dummy Poly
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (retail sets it on 26 rows, mostly lever and corpse prompts).

Fields.Name: Textbox Type
Fields.Description: Prompt box style. Only 0 (Action Button) exists and retail always uses 0; stored with the prompt, no effect found.
Padding.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Is Invalid when Riding
Fields.Description: If set, the prompt is hidden while the player is riding Torrent. Also stops Riding Override ID from applying.

Fields.Name: Is Grayed Out when Riding
Fields.Description: If set, the prompt is shown greyed out (and can't be used) while the player is riding Torrent. Also stops Riding Override ID from applying.

Fields.Name: Is Invalid when Crouching
Fields.Description: If set, the prompt is hidden while the player is crouching.

Fields.Name: Is Grayed Out when Crouching
Fields.Description: If set, the prompt is shown greyed out (and can't be used) while the player is crouching.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Action Button Text (FMG) entry shown on the prompt.

Fields.Name: Hide Event Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag: while it is ON the prompt is hidden. 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: Grey Out Event Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag: while it is ON the prompt is shown greyed out and can't be used. 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: Riding Override ID
Fields.Description: ActionButtonParam row used instead of this one while the player is riding Torrent (its region, text and conditions). Ignored if either riding flag is set on this row. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Cooldown After Use
Fields.Description: After the prompt is used, it stays unavailable for this many seconds. Negative: it doesn't come back while its source keeps it registered (retail -1 on one-time actions). 0: available again at once.
Padding.
